novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new defensive hypothesis—“a student can be ‘immunized’ by penalizing … any activation-gradient component that concentrates along a consistent low-rank direction”—rather than merely a new setting, using gradient orthogonalization as the proposed mechanism. The closest prior work is “Subliminal Learning Is Steering Vector Distillation,” which identifies the “small but consistent component along the steering direction,” while “Subliminal Steering” and “Channel Location Constrains the Auditability of Subliminal Learning” provide related mechanistic localization and mitigation analyses; searches for “subliminal learning defense,” “steering vector distillation gradient orthogonalization,” “trait-agnostic training-time defense,” and “gradient projection distillation” did not reveal an essentially equivalent training-time intervention. The step from those works to this claim is a substantive but natural extension—repurposing a diagnosed gradient signature as a single-source, trait-agnostic regularizer—so the core direction is more than a direct object transfer but does not establish a wholly new optimization paradigm, warranting 6 rather than 7–8.
